    Atlético San Luis hosts Club León on March 21, 2026, at 9 p.m. ET (March 22, 01:00 UTC) at Estadio Alfonso Lastras Ramírez for a Liga MX Clausura match. As of March 21, San Luis sits 13th and León 16th. Both teams have shown high-scoring trends, with over 1.5 goals in 82% of their recent matches. 
    Key Details and Stats: 
    • Form & Standing: San Luis (13th) hosts León (16th), with both teams having struggled recently.

    • Expected Goals (xG): Recent data suggests a low-scoring game might be expected, with combined expected goals of 1.64 (1.04 for San Luis at home, 0.60 for León away).
    • Key Players: Diber Cambindo has been noted for having the most shots on target per match for Leon.
    • Recent Match Trends: 5 of Leon's last 6 Liga MX matches ended with over 2.5 goals.
